opportunities.description: BRIEF TÉCNICO DE PRODUCCIÓN AUDIOVISUAL Cliente: Priscila Bethancourt. Tipo de proyecto: Producción audiovisual explicativa, académica e institucional. 1. OBJETIVO DEL PROYECTO Producir un video resumen de una investigación universitaria sobre las alertas meteorológicas en a. El objetivo es transformar el contenido de la investigación en una pieza audiovisual dinámica, visualmente atractiva y fácil de comprender, que mantenga la atención de los espectadores y permita explicar los principales conceptos, datos y conclusiones del trabajo. No se busca una presentación convencional de diapositivas, sino una producción audiovisual con recursos gráficos, animaciones, infografías y material visual de apoyo. 2. MATERIALES PROPORCIONADOS POR LA CLIENTE La cliente compartió una carpeta de Google Drive con el material de producción: Según lo indicado por la cliente, contiene: 1. Guion: estructura y contenido narrativo del video. 2. Storyboard: referencia visual de las escenas y los elementos que podrían acompañar cada fragmento de la locución. 3. Locución: narración de voz en off que servirá como base para organizar y sincronizar el video. 4. Clips audiovisuales: videos que pueden utilizarse como material complementario en determinadas escenas. 5. Logotipos: recursos de identidad visual para incorporar donde corresponda. La cliente confirma que el storyboard es orientativo y que no es obligatorio reproducir exactamente sus indicaciones. Existe libertad creativa para proponer soluciones visuales que mejoren el resultado. Antes de comenzar: revisar todos los archivos de la carpeta, escuchar la locución completa y estudiar el guion y storyboard. 3. DIRECCIÓN CREATIVA Y ESTILO VISUAL La cliente quiere un video dinámico que mantenga la atención de los espectadores. Se recomienda una estética: - Profesional, moderna e institucional. - Académica, pero visualmente atractiva. - Limpia y organizada. - Con buena jerarquía visual. - Con transiciones fluidas y movimientos naturales. - Con variedad de recursos gráficos para evitar escenas estáticas prolongadas. Se pueden combinar infografías animadas, ilustraciones, mapas, estadísticas, textos, iconos, imágenes y clips reales. La animación debe cumplir una función explicativa, no utilizarse únicamente como decoración. 4. RECURSOS VISUALES QUE DEBE INCLUIR LA PRODUCCIÓN A. Infografías y estadísticas - Representación visual de datos relevantes de la investigación. - Gráficos animados y elementos estadísticos. - Diagramas y esquemas explicativos. - Cifras y conceptos destacados en pantalla. B. Mapas y elementos meteorológicos - Mapas de República Dominicana cuando corresponda. - Representaciones visuales de alertas meteorológicas. - Iconografía relacionada con el clima y los fenómenos meteorológicos. - Elementos gráficos que ayuden a explicar la información geográfica. C. Textos y títulos - Títulos animados. - Palabras clave destacadas. - Textos explicativos breves. - Subtítulos sincronizados con la narración. D. Animaciones y transiciones - Movimientos gráficos fluidos. - Transiciones profesionales. - Animación de elementos visuales. - Composiciones dinámicas que acompañen la explicación. E. Clips y recursos audiovisuales - Aprovechar los videos proporcionados por la cliente cuando sean relevantes. - Incorporar los logotipos suministrados. - Combinar material real con recursos gráficos para enriquecer la narrativa. 5. ESTRUCTURA NARRATIVA La producción debe seguir el guion y la locución proporcionados por la cliente. Como referencia, la narrativa contempla: 1. Introducción y presentación del tema. 2. Contexto de las alertas meteorológicas en República Dominicana. 3. Desarrollo de los aspectos principales de la investigación. 4. Presentación de datos y hallazgos relevantes. 5. Conclusiones y cierre. El orden definitivo debe respetar el guion entregado. No agregar información, estadísticas ni conclusiones que no estén respaldadas por el material de la investigación. 6. AUDIO Y LOCUCIÓN - Utilizar la locución proporcionada por la cliente. - Sincronizar las escenas y animaciones con la narración. - Incorporar música de fondo apropiada para una producción académica e institucional. - Realizar mezcla y nivelación de audio. - Mantener la voz clara y por encima de la música. - Incorporar efectos sonoros sutiles cuando aporten valor. La locución será la guía principal para establecer el ritmo y la duración de las escenas. 7. ESPECIFICACIONES TÉCNICAS - Duración estimada: 2 minutos y 30 segundos a 3 minutos y 30 segundos. - Orientación: horizontal 16:9. - Resolución: 1920 × 1080 píxeles. - Calidad: Full HD. - Formato de entrega: MP4. - Audio: locución, música y mezcla. - Textos: títulos y subtítulos integrados. La duración debe ajustarse al contenido real de la locución y al guion aprobado. 8. ENTREGABLE FINAL Se debe entregar: 1. Video completo en formato MP4 y resolución Full HD. 2. Todas las escenas editadas y ensambladas. 3. Recursos gráficos, infografías y animaciones integrados. 4. Locución sincronizada. 5. Música de fondo y mezcla de audio. 6. Subtítulos integrados. 7. Transiciones y acabado audiovisual profesional. 9. RONDAS DE CORRECCIONES El proyecto contempla dos rondas de ajustes gratuitos: Primera ronda: correcciones generales de textos, escenas, sincronización, gráficos y detalles visuales. Segunda ronda: aplicación de observaciones finales y refinamiento de los elementos previamente corregidos. Las correcciones deben mantenerse dentro del guion, storyboard y alcance acordados. Los cambios sustanciales de concepto, nuevas secciones o ampliaciones importantes del contenido quedan fuera de las revisiones ordinarias. 10. CRITERIOS DE CALIDAD El resultado debe cumplir con lo siguiente: - Mantener la atención del espectador. - Tener una narrativa visual coherente. - Evitar escenas excesivamente estáticas. - Presentar datos e infografías fáciles de comprender. - Utilizar animaciones que refuercen la explicación. - Mantener consistencia gráfica durante todo el video. - Respetar el contenido académico de la investigación. - Garantizar buena sincronización entre imagen y locución. - Tener un acabado profesional apropiado para una presentación universitaria. INSTRUCCIÓN GENERAL PARA EL EDITOR La prioridad es convertir el guion, storyboard y locución de la cliente en un video explicativo de calidad profesional. La cliente no ha establecido ningún software ni técnica de producción obligatoria. El editor tiene libertad para seleccionar las herramientas y los métodos de trabajo que considere más adecuados, siempre que se respete el resultado visual solicitado. Se recomienda dar protagonismo a las infografías, mapas, estadísticas y elementos animados, combinándolos con clips reales y otros recursos visuales cuando corresponda. Importante: no comenzar a producir escenas aisladas sin revisar primero la totalidad de la locución y el storyboard. Es necesario organizar la secuencia completa, identificar qué recurso visual acompañará cada fragmento de audio y mantener una continuidad narrativa de principio a fin.

Clips y recursos audiovisuales - Aprovechar los videos proporcionados por la cliente cuando sean relevantes. - Incorporar los logotipos suministrados. - Combinar material real con recursos gráficos para enriquecer la narrativa. 5. ESTRUCTURA NARRATIVA La producción debe seguir el guion y la locución proporcionados por la cliente. Como referencia, la narrativa contempla: 1. Introducción y presentación del tema. 2. Contexto de las alertas meteorológicas en República Dominicana. 3. Desarrollo de los aspectos principales de la investigación. 4. Presentación de datos y hallazgos relevantes. 5. Conclusiones y cierre. El orden definitivo debe respetar el guion entregado. No agregar información, estadísticas ni conclusiones que no estén respaldadas por el material de la investigación. 6. AUDIO Y LOCUCIÓN - Utilizar la locución proporcionada por la cliente. - Sincronizar las escenas y animaciones con la narración. - Incorporar música de fondo apropiada para una producción académica e institucional. - Realizar mezcla y nivelación de audio. - Mantener la voz clara y por encima de la música. - Incorporar efectos sonoros sutiles cuando aporten valor. La locución será la guía principal para establecer el ritmo y la duración de las escenas. 7. ESPECIFICACIONES TÉCNICAS - Duración estimada: 2 minutos y 30 segundos a 3 minutos y 30 segundos. - Orientación: horizontal 16:9. - Resolución: 1920 × 1080 píxeles. - Calidad: Full HD. - Formato de entrega: MP4. - Audio: locución, música y mezcla. - Textos: títulos y subtítulos integrados. La duración debe ajustarse al contenido real de la locución y al guion aprobado. 8. ENTREGABLE FINAL Se debe entregar: 1. Video completo en formato MP4 y resolución Full HD. 2. Todas las escenas editadas y ensambladas. 3. Recursos gráficos, infografías y animaciones integrados. 4. Locución sincronizada. 5. Música de fondo y mezcla de audio. 6. Subtítulos integrados. 7. Transiciones y acabado audiovisual profesional. 9. RONDAS DE CORRECCIONES El proyecto contempla dos rondas de ajustes gratuitos: Primera ronda: correcciones generales de textos, escenas, sincronización, gráficos y detalles visuales. Segunda ronda: aplicación de observaciones finales y refinamiento de los elementos previamente corregidos. Las correcciones deben mantenerse dentro del guion, storyboard y alcance acordados. Los cambios sustanciales de concepto, nuevas secciones o ampliaciones importantes del contenido quedan fuera de las revisiones ordinarias. 10. CRITERIOS DE CALIDAD El resultado debe cumplir con lo siguiente: - Mantener la atención del espectador. - Tener una narrativa visual coherente. - Evitar escenas excesivamente estáticas. - Presentar datos e infografías fáciles de comprender. - Utilizar animaciones que refuercen la explicación. - Mantener consistencia gráfica durante todo el video. - Respetar el contenido académico de la investigación. - Garantizar buena sincronización entre imagen y locución. - Tener un acabado profesional apropiado para una presentación universitaria. INSTRUCCIÓN GENERAL PARA EL EDITOR La prioridad es convertir el guion, storyboard y locución de la cliente en un video explicativo de calidad profesional. La cliente no ha establecido ningún software ni técnica de producción obligatoria. El editor tiene libertad para seleccionar las herramientas y los métodos de trabajo que considere más adecuados, siempre que se respete el resultado visual solicitado. Se recomienda dar protagonismo a las infografías, mapas, estadísticas y elementos animados, combinándolos con clips reales y otros recursos visuales cuando corresponda. Importante: no comenzar a producir escenas aisladas sin revisar primero la totalidad de la locución y el storyboard. Es necesario organizar la secuencia completa, identificar qué recurso visual acompañará cada fragmento de audio y mantener una continuidad narrativa de principio a fin."

opportunities.title: Cold Caller B2B con Español por Comisión -- 2
opportunities.description: Busco alguien ambicioso, que tenga experiencia realizando Cold Calls y quiera hacer dinero. Solo se aceptan candidatos con Español nativo, o con excelente manejo del mismo. Nuestra empresa ofrece servicios de marketing digital, software dedicado y diseño web a otras empresas, por lo que seria ideal que tu cuentes con experiencia B2B. No queremos a un empleado, queremos a alguien se se sume al proyecto y trabaje igual de duro que todos nosotros para que, en equipo, podamos hacer dinero. No recibirás un sueldo ( mientras estes en tu periodo de prueba ) pero si recibirás un 10% de cada venta cerrada por nuestro equipo de closers que TU hayas logrado pasar a WhatsApp, lo que supondría como mínimo, de 100 a 500 dólares por venta para ti, ya que nuestro ticket mas bajo comienza en los $999 y no tiene techo, llegando a poder hacer paquetes de 30k. Esa será tu única tarea, llamar a pequeñas, medianas y grandes empresas hispanas en todo el mundo con la finalidad de llevarlos a WhatsApp, para que nosotros podamos hacerle el appointment Setting. Una vez pases el periodo de prueba, seguidas cobrando en base a comisiones, pero se te añadirá un fijo mensual basado en cuantas llamadas seas capaz de hacer al dia.

opportunities.title: Logo minimalista para marca textil
opportunities.description: Busco un diseño de logo limpio, elegante y minimalista que represente mi nueva marca de remeras y pantalones cortos — el short de color azul es un elemento clave de la identidad, así que debe quedar claro, ya sea a través de la paleta cromática, un ícono sutil o un detalle gráfico distintivo. Necesito recibir varias propuestas originales para poder elegir la que mejor capture el espíritu fresco y moderno de la marca. El logo se aplicará directamente sobre las prendas, de modo que la legibilidad y la versatilidad en distintas tallas y telas son fundamentales. Entregables imprescindibles • Versión principal en formato vector (AI, SVG o EPS) • Archivos PNG y JPG en alta resolución con fondo transparente • Variante monocromática y prueba a una tinta • Mock-up sobre remera y sobre pantalón corto azul para visualizar la aplicación real Criterios de selección – Estilo minimalista y elegante, evitando recargar trazos o tipografías. – Fácil de reproducir en serigrafía, bordado y sublimación. – Coherencia cromática con el azul protagonista del short. Quiero escoger diseño ganador lo más pronto posible, así que valoraré entregas tempranas y revisiones ágiles. ¡Espero ver tu mejor creatividad!
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40814154, publicado hace 1 día). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 250 - 750.

opportunities.title: Televentas Upsell en Español
opportunities.description: Tengo una base de clientes que ya utilizan algunos de nuestros servicios y quiero maximizar el valor de cada cuenta. Necesito apoyo de un vendedor nativo o bilingüe en español que se encargue exclusivamente de ventas por teléfono. La tarea consiste en llamar a estos clientes actuales, detectar necesidades adicionales y cerrar la venta durante la misma conversación. No es un rol de prospección ni de agendar citas: el éxito se mide porque el cliente acepte la oferta y realice la compra en la llamada. Para trabajar cómodamente compartiré: • Listado depurado de clientes con historial y notas. • Guión flexible, precios y argumentario de beneficios. • Acceso al CRM para registrar cada intento y resultado. Qué espero recibir al final de cada jornada: • Registro actualizado en el CRM con estado de cada llamada. • Grabaciones o resumen escrito de objeciones y cómo se resolvieron. • Número de ventas cerradas y monto total. El producto ya es conocido por el cliente, así que la conversación será directa y orientada a valor adicional. Si ya tienes experiencia en upselling telefónico, dominan técnicas de cierre inmediato y te sientes cómodo trabajando con métricas diarias, avísame y arrancamos lo antes posible.

La tarea consiste en llamar a estos clientes actuales, detectar necesidades adicionales y cerrar la venta durante la misma conversación. No es un rol de prospección ni de agendar citas: el éxito se mide porque el cliente acepte la oferta y realice la compra en la llamada. Para trabajar cómodamente compartiré: • Listado depurado de clientes con historial y notas. • Guión flexible, precios y argumentario de beneficios. • Acceso al CRM para registrar cada intento y resultado. Qué espero recibir al final de cada jornada: • Registro actualizado en el CRM con estado de cada llamada. • Grabaciones o resumen escrito de objeciones y cómo se resolvieron. • Número de ventas cerradas y monto total. El producto ya es conocido por el cliente, así que la conversación será directa y orientada a valor adicional. Si ya tienes experiencia en upselling telefónico, dominan técnicas de cierre inmediato y te sientes cómodo trabajando con métricas diarias, avísame y arrancamos lo antes posible."

opportunities.title: Videos IA para YouTube
opportunities.description: Quiero profesionalizar mi nuevo canal de YouTube con ayuda de inteligencia artificial. Trabajo tres temas —Educación, Tecnología y Liderazgo— y ya cuento con abundante contenido propio (dos libros publicados, más de 100 artículos en LinkedIn y más de 120 artículos adicionales). Objetivo • Aumentar audiencia y suscriptores en YouTube entre profesionales y líderes de empresas. Alcance del trabajo 1. Estrategia de estilo • Definir look & feel, ritmo y narrativa óptimos para cada uno de los tres temas, siempre basados en narración con imágenes, texto y clips generados por IA. 2. Guión y storyboard ligero • Seleccionar ideas clave de mis libros y artículos para estructurar cada video. 3. Producción de video • Crear 1 video corto (≤60 s estilo YouTube Shorts) y 1 video largo (6-10 min) por tema, usando herramientas IA como Pictory, Synthesia, D-ID o equivalentes para voz en off, montaje de clips y subtítulos automáticos. 4. Miniaturas y copy • Diseñar una miniatura atractiva por video, coherente con el estilo definido. Incluir título y texto de enganche. 5. Entrega final • Videos en formato 1080p listos para subir. • Thumbnails en PNG 1280 × 720. • Documento breve con lineamientos de estilo y recomendaciones de publicación (títulos, descripciones, hashtags, calendario). Requisitos deseables • Experiencia previa creando contenido con IA para YouTube. • Manejo de herramientas como Midjourney, Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro o similares. • Conocimiento de SEO para YouTube orientado a público ejecutivo. Estoy en Ciudad de México; la colaboración puede ser remota, pero se valorará disponibilidad para llamadas en horario local.

opportunities.title: Comercial freelance a comisión en Madrid – Captación de negocios locales
opportunities.description: En The Why Reworks (TWR) gestionamos publicidad digital (Meta Ads, Google Ads y TikTok Ads) para negocios locales y marcas emergentes en Madrid: restaurantes, cafeterías, peluquerías, centros de estética, tiendas de moda, estudios de fitness… Buscamos comerciales freelance en Madrid que nos presenten negocios con los que podamos trabajar. TU TRABAJO - Identificar negocios de Madrid (preferiblemente dentro de la M-30) que puedan beneficiarse de la publicidad digital. - Contactarlos por teléfono, en persona o a través de tu propia red de contactos. - Conseguir una primera llamada entre el dueño o responsable y nosotros. El cierre, la propuesta y la gestión del cliente los hacemos nosotros. REMUNERACIÓN - 100% a comisión: 20% recurrente sobre lo que factura cada cliente que traigas, cada mes, mientras siga con nosotros. - Con nuestra tarifa estándar (400 €/mes + IVA), son 80 €/mes por cliente activo. Con 10 clientes activos, 800 €/mes recurrentes. - Sin objetivos mínimos ni horarios. TE DAMOS - Presentación del servicio, precios claros e informe de ejemplo. - Un servicio fácil de explicar: precio fijo, sin permanencias largas y sin promesas imposibles. BUSCAMOS - Residencia en Madrid o contacto habitual con negocios de Madrid. - Experiencia vendiendo a pequeños negocios (hostelería, belleza, retail…) o una buena red de contactos en ese sector. - Trato cercano y honesto. No buscamos venta agresiva. - Valorable: conocer el marketing o la publicidad digital, o trabajar ya con estos negocios (fotografía, diseño, distribución, asesoría…). IMPORTANTE: el contacto con los negocios debe hacerse por teléfono, en persona o a través de tu red. No se permiten campañas de email, WhatsApp ni mensajes en frío por redes sociales. EN TU PROPUESTA, CUÉNTANOS 1. Qué experiencia tienes vendiendo a negocios locales. 2. Con qué tipo de negocios de Madrid tienes relación o contacto. 3. Cuántas horas a la semana podrías dedicarle.

opportunities.title: Expert Cabinet Vision Joinery Drafter
opportunities.description: I'm looking for an experienced Cabinet Vision Drafter to assist with ongoing commercial and residential joinery drafting projects. The ideal candidate must have strong experience producing accurate, detailed, manufacturing-ready Cabinet Vision models and professional shop drawings. I will provide project requirements, architectural drawings, construction specifications, drafting standards, and detailed instructions for each assignment. Your responsibility will be to independently complete the assigned drafting work, ensure everything follows the provided standards, and submit the completed deliverables for my review. This is a hands-on technical drafting role, not simply a 2D CAD drawing position. Key Responsibilities - Interpret architectural drawings, specifications, and joinery requirements. - Create accurate 3D joinery models using Cabinet Vision. - Prepare detailed shop drawings, including plans, elevations, sections, and construction details. - Develop manufacturing-ready cabinetry models with correct construction methods. - Follow provided construction standards, material specifications, hardware requirements, and drafting templates. - Work with Cabinet Vision UCS rules, parametric assemblies, and hardware libraries. - Ensure accurate panel dimensions, edge banding, drilling positions, clearances, and joinery connections. - Prepare production information, including cutlists and material schedules where required. - Identify missing information, technical conflicts, or potential manufacturing issues before proceeding. - Make revisions based on feedback and deliver final files within agreed deadlines. - Maintain consistency across multiple joinery units within the same project. Required Skills - Advanced proficiency in Cabinet Vision. - Strong experience in commercial joinery, custom cabinetry, kitchens, wardrobes, vanities, and fit-outs. - Excellent understanding of cabinetry construction and manufacturing processes. - Experience producing detailed, manufacturing-ready shop drawings. - Familiarity with Cabinet Vision UCS, parametric modelling, and customized libraries. - Knowledge of CNC manufacturing requirements and nested-based production. - Ability to interpret architectural drawings and work accurately with metric dimensions. - Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently. - Reliable communication and timely delivery. Preferred Qualifications - Experience working with commercial joinery or cabinet manufacturing companies. - Experience with complex commercial fit-outs and custom joinery. - Ability to understand and adapt quickly to established construction standards. - Experience with AutoCAD. - Familiarity with materials such as melamine, laminate, MDF, timber veneer, and stone. Workflow 1. I will provide the project drawings, specifications, construction standards, and expected deliverables. 2. You will review the requirements and raise any questions before starting. 3. You will complete the Cabinet Vision models and shop drawings independently. 4. You will submit the completed files for my review. 5. You will make any necessary corrections and provide the final deliverables. All work must follow the supplied construction standards and be suitable for manufacturing. Expected Deliverables - Cabinet Vision project files and models. - Complete shop drawing sets in PDF format. - Plans, elevations, sections, and construction details. - Material and hardware specifications. - Manufacturing-ready production information, as required. - Revised and finalized project files. Application Requirements Please include the following information in your proposal: 1. How many years of experience do you have with Cabinet Vision? 2. Which version of Cabinet Vision do you currently use? 3. Have you worked on commercial joinery or custom cabinetry projects? 4. Are you experienced with UCS rules and customized construction libraries? 5. Can you provide samples of your previous Cabinet Vision shop drawings? 6. What is your hourly rate and weekly availability? 7. Are you comfortable working independently from detailed written specifications? Important: Please provide actual Cabinet Vision work samples demonstrating your ability to produce accurate, manufacturing-ready joinery drawings. I'm looking for someone reliable, technically skilled, detail-oriented, and interested in a long-term working relationship.

opportunities.title: LinkedIn AI Outreach Assistant
opportunities.description: I want to put an AI-powered assistant in charge of my LinkedIn messaging so every potential client receives a timely, relevant reply without me living in the inbox. The goal is twofold: automatically handle all incoming messages and proactively search LinkedIn for new prospects, sending them a personalised introduction that feels human, not scripted. Key objectives • Detect any new message, comment, or connection request on my LinkedIn profile and generate a context-aware response that fits my brand voice. • Identify profiles that match criteria I will provide (industry, role, location, etc.) and start a conversation aimed at converting them into clients. • Keep a full log of all AI interactions so I can review, step in, or adjust the strategy whenever needed. I’m open to whichever stack you prefer—OpenAI / GPT, LinkedIn API work-arounds, Phantombuster, Zapier, Make, custom Python scripts—so long as the final workflow is reliable and remains within LinkedIn’s usage limits. Deliverables 1. A working LinkedIn assistant that runs autonomously in the cloud. 2. A simple dashboard or Google Sheet that tracks outreach, replies, follow-ups, and key metrics. 3. Step-by-step hand-off documentation so I can tweak prompts or targeting rules without touching code. I’ll supply the messaging style guide, prospect filters, and access tokens once we begin. If you have previous examples of LinkedIn automation or conversational AI you’ve built, please mention them when you respond.

opportunities.description: **Part-Time B2B Sales Representative — Business Process Automation Software** We’re seeking an experienced B2B sales professional to drive sales of our business process automation software across the **US, UK, Australia, and New Zealand**. This role requires ownership of the **complete sales cycle**, from identifying qualified prospects and initiating conversations to negotiating proposals and closing deals. **Responsibilities** - Identify and engage relevant businesses and decision-makers. - Generate qualified leads through targeted outbound prospecting. - Understand client needs and communicate the value of our software. - Coordinate sales meetings and product demonstrations with our team. - Manage proposals, follow-ups, negotiations, and deal closure. - Maintain an accurate pipeline and provide regular progress updates. **Experience and Skills** - **3–5 years of successful B2B sales experience**, preferably in SaaS, business automation, or technology solutions. - A demonstrated track record of winning clients and closing deals. - Experience selling into one or more of our target markets. - Strong communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills. - Ability to work independently and take responsibility for sales outcomes. **Compensation and Working Arrangement** - **Fixed monthly compensation: USD $133.** - **Additional commission: 2% on each successfully closed deal.** - Part-time, remote engagement with flexible working hours. - Manage your own schedule while accommodating prospect meetings and agreed commitments. - Contract continuation will depend solely on results against mutually agreed sales targets. Outreach activity alone will not determine renewal. **To Apply** Please share your relevant sales experience, markets served, examples of measurable results, and how you would approach your first 30 days. Include your availability and confirmation that the stated compensation structure fits your expectations.

opportunities.title: Parkhurst QLD Australia RPEQ-Linked Subdivision Civil Design
opportunities.description: I’m progressing a Queensland operational works submission for a new subdivision and have reached the point where full civil design is required. Concept plans are already prepared; what I now need is the complete detailed design package that turns those concepts into council-ready, RPEQ-signed drawings. The project involves a subdivision with drainage, sewer, water services, roads, utilities and associated earthworks, all to be delivered under current Australian Standards, QUDM, IPWEAQ and local council guidelines. Whether you hold the RPEQ yourself or collaborate closely with someone who does, the end result must be drawings and calculations ready for formal lodgement and approval in Queensland. AutoCAD Civil 3D (or 12d), DRAINS, MUSIC and similar industry tools are the expected platforms so the files integrate smoothly with council requirements. Acceptance of the work hinges on the following discrete deliverables: • Full set of operational works drawings (roads, kerbs, stormwater, sewer, water, earthworks) in DWG and PDF • Design reports and hydraulic/hydrologic calculations that match the drawings • Compliance notes demonstrating adherence to relevant Australian and QLD codes • RPEQ certification on the cover sheet and any documents that require it Provide a brief outline of your proposed workflow, the RPEQ arrangement you have in place, and the software you intend to use, and we can move straight into the detailed design phase.

opportunities.title: Gearbox Actuator Design & ANSYS -- 2
opportunities.description: I’m developing a compact gearbox-based actuator and need a mechanical engineer who can carry the concept all the way through detailed verification in ANSYS. Your job starts with refining my preliminary sketches (or proposing your own concept if it proves better), modelling each gear, shaft, housing and bearing, and then setting up all necessary simulations inside ANSYS Workbench. The core objective is to confirm the design’s reliability under realistic loads: bending and torsion on the shafts, contact stresses on the gears, bolt preload in the housing, and overall deformation. Alongside static strength, I also want to see motion behaviour over a full duty cycle so I can verify backlash, efficiency and potential resonance points. If you already have macros or scripts that speed up these studies, all the better. Once the results are in, I’ll need recommendations on material grades, surface treatments and any geometric tweaks that improve durability or reduce weight without driving up machining costs. Organise the findings clearly—screen grabs, contour plots, safety factors—so they can be dropped straight into my project file and shown to the machinist. Deliverables • Parametric 3D CAD files (STEP or native SolidWorks/Inventor) • Complete ANSYS workbench file(s) with solved studies • PDF report summarising loads, boundary conditions, assumptions, results and design changes • Final manufacturing drawings with tolerances, fits and a revision block I will be available daily for quick clarifications and can share load specs, space constraints and photos of the surrounding assembly on request. Let me know your preferred CAD package, ANSYS version and estimated turnaround time so we can lock in milestones right away. I need the freelancer to share their portfolio as a pdf first then only I can choose

The core objective is to confirm the design’s reliability under realistic loads: bending and torsion on the shafts, contact stresses on the gears, bolt preload in the housing, and overall deformation. Alongside static strength, I also want to see motion behaviour over a full duty cycle so I can verify backlash, efficiency and potential resonance points. If you already have macros or scripts that speed up these studies, all the better. Once the results are in, I’ll need recommendations on material grades, surface treatments and any geometric tweaks that improve durability or reduce weight without driving up machining costs. Organise the findings clearly—screen grabs, contour plots, safety factors—so they can be dropped straight into my project file and shown to the machinist. Deliverables • Parametric 3D CAD files (STEP or native SolidWorks/Inventor) • Complete ANSYS workbench file(s) with solved studies • PDF report summarising loads, boundary conditions, assumptions, results and design changes • Final manufacturing drawings with tolerances, fits and a revision block I will be available daily for quick clarifications and can share load specs, space constraints and photos of the surrounding assembly on request. Let me know your preferred CAD package, ANSYS version and estimated turnaround time so we can lock in milestones right away. I need the freelancer to share their portfolio as a pdf first then only I can choose

opportunities.title: Barbershop Walk-In Queue Management System
opportunities.description: Hello, I can build a custom **Barbershop Walk-In Check-In & Queue Management System** that keeps your barbers' workflow simple while giving you complete control over walk-ins and customer data. The system can work alongside your existing setup, so your barbers can keep their **personal booking links on the website** instead of being forced to use another booking platform. ### Key Features I Can Build: - **Walk-In Customer Check-In** - Customer enters name, phone number, email, and service. - Automatically receives a queue position and estimated wait time. - **Returning Customer Check-In** - Customer enters their phone number. - Existing profile is automatically found. - They can check in quickly without entering all their information again. - **Barber Availability Dashboard** - Barbers enter their availability each morning. - No Google Calendar/Fresha/Square integration required. - Simple start/end time and break management. - **Automatic Queue Management** - Customers are placed in order. - System determines the next available barber based on availability. - Queue status updates automatically. - **Waiting Room Display** - Large monitor/TV display showing customer names, positions, and estimated wait times. - Automatically updates as customers move through the queue. - No private phone/email information displayed publicly. - **Barber Dashboard** - See assigned customer. - Start service. - Complete service. - System automatically moves to the next customer. - **Admin Dashboard** - Today's walk-ins - Current waiting customers - Average wait time - Completed services - Barber activity - Customer history - **Customer Database / CRM** - Store customer name, phone, email, visit history, preferred barber, and services. - Search returning customers by phone number. - **Marketing & Customer Retention** - Marketing consent during check-in. - Customer segmentation. - Ability to identify customers who haven't visited recently. - Foundation for future email/SMS/WhatsApp campaigns and loyalty features. ### Suggested Technology I can build this as a responsive web application using: **Laravel + PHP + MySQL + Bootstrap + JavaScript/AJAX** This will allow the system to run on a front-desk computer/tablet and a separate TV/monitor without requiring customers or barbers to install an app. Most importantly, I would keep the barber experience extremely simple: **Morning:** Set availability → Done. **During the day:** Start Client → Finish Client → Next Client. The goal is to make the system easier than Fresha/Square rather than creating another complicated application. I can also structure the system so your existing website keeps the **individual barber booking links**, while the new **Walk-In Check-In** option handles customers who physically walk into the shop. I'm ready to discuss the workflow and build the first version of the system based on your shop's actual process. Best regards, **Dipen Patel**

opportunities.title: Automated IQ Option Copy Trading
opportunities.description: I need a fully-automated solution that connects to IQ Option, watches several specific traders of my choosing, determines which one is currently performing best, and mirrors every new position to my own account instantly without pausing for manual approval. Key points of the workflow • The tool must track multiple traders in real time, continuously updating performance statistics so it can switch to the top performer whenever results shift. • Once the best trader is identified, every trade they open should be duplicated in my account with identical parameters (instrument, direction, stake, expiry, etc.) the moment the order is placed. • I want the list of traders to be editable and the performance comparison logic to be clearly documented so I can refine the criteria later if needed. Deliverables 1. Source code for the copy-trading bot (Python, Node, or another widely supported language that works with IQ Option’s API or websocket). 2. Simple configuration file or UI where I enter the trader IDs I wish to monitor. 3. Installation guide plus a brief video or screenshots showing the bot in action on a demo account to confirm it switches traders correctly and executes copied orders without delay. Acceptance criteria • Latency between the original and copied trade stays under two seconds. • Bot runs unattended for at least eight continuous hours without crashing. • Detailed log file records which trader was followed and every trade replicated.

opportunities.title: Personal Errand & Task Organizer
opportunities.description: My days move fast and I need a detail-minded organiser to keep my personal life running just as smoothly. The core focus is arranging and tracking all of my shopping, bookings, and appointments so nothing is ever missed or double-booked. Here’s what the work looks like day to day: you will confirm doctor or salon slots, place online orders, chase delivery updates, and secure restaurant or event reservations. When something changes, you reshuffle the plan, notify me immediately, and lock in the new time or service. Each errand should be logged in a shared, easy-to-scan list (Google Sheets, Notion, or a simple spreadsheet—whatever you prefer, as long as it stays current). We’ll communicate almost exclusively through WhatsApp or standard text messages. Quick responses during my local business hours are important so I can approve or redirect tasks in real time. Deliverables I expect • Up-to-date tracker of all open errands with status and due dates • Confirmations or receipts forwarded as they arrive • A brief weekly summary highlighting what was completed and what’s coming up Accuracy, discretion, and proactive follow-ups are essential. If you thrive on keeping chaos under control, you’ll find this straightforward and satisfying work.

opportunities.title: Boost Restaurant & Stall Traffic
opportunities.description: I run a pure-vegetarian restaurant just a few steps from the Char Dham temple in Vrindavan. Footfall is low and, at the same time, I have several small food-stall counters in front of the main building that are sitting idle. My goal is two-fold: fill more tables inside and secure reliable tenants for those stalls, all without losing the devotional, family-friendly atmosphere that temple visitors expect. The audience we want to reach is clear—pilgrims walking to and from the temple, local families who pass by daily, and tourists lodged in nearby hotels. Inside the restaurant we already serve classic North-Indian thalis, fresh snacks, and quick-grab drinks, so any campaign or onsite activation should highlight that vegetarian purity and speed of service. Here’s what I need from you: • A concise, actionable promotion plan that drives immediate footfall—think low-cost digital ads (Meta, Google), collaborations with hotel concierges, pilgrim-oriented flyers, and simple influencer tie-ups on Instagram/Reels. • Creative collateral—menu posters, social media templates, and short copy variants I can reuse month-to-month. • A strategy (and sample listing text) for renting out each food stall, including positioning, expected rent, and the best online/offline channels to reach interested vendors. • A short calendar that sequences both restaurant promotions and stall-rental outreach so they don’t compete for attention. • Clear metrics to track success—daily covers, enquiry calls, stall-rental leads—plus a quick-reference sheet I can update myself. Please keep the plan practical for a small business owner: minimal jargon, tools my staff can manage (Canva, WhatsApp, Meta Ads Manager), and budget-friendly tactics first. If you can show examples of similar hospitality turnarounds or tenant-sourcing campaigns you’ve executed, that will help me assess fit quickly. I’m ready to move fast and will provide current menus, photos, and layout diagrams as soon as we start.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40816229, publicado hace 4 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 1,500 - 12,500.

opportunities.title: Farmhouse Plot Brochure Layout
opportunities.description: I have a parcel of land that will be split into individual farmhouse plots and now need a polished master layout that can drop straight into my sales brochure. The drawing must clearly show every plot, the internal road network, generous green spaces, and the locations earmarked for shared facilities so buyers immediately feel the development’s quality. Beyond accuracy, the artwork has to look premium—clean lines, balanced colours, and a presentation style that photographs well in print and on screen. I will rely on this single sheet to convince prospects, so legibility and curb-appeal are equally important. Please deliver: • A dimensioned, scalable base plan in a fully editable format (DWG or layered Illustrator/PSD). • A high-resolution, print-ready PDF/JPEG rendered in marketing colours. If you already use tools such as AutoCAD, Illustrator, Corel, or SketchUp for plan rendering, that aligns perfectly with the outcome I need. Turnaround can be discussed, but I would like to move quickly once you have my site measurements.

opportunities.description: I’m ready to move forward with the complete architectural design of a new single-family home and I’m looking for a creative architect who can translate my ideas into clear, build-ready documents. The scope covers everything from initial concept sketches through detailed floor plans, elevations, sections, and, if possible, a few 3D views to help me visualise the spaces before construction begins. Please include samples of your past work on comparable residential projects when you reply—seeing what you have already delivered for other clients will help me understand your style and technical depth. My priority is a design that balances aesthetics, functionality, and cost-effective construction methods while respecting local building codes. If you have experience in energy-efficient layouts or sustainable materials, feel free to highlight that as well. Once we agree on the overall concept, I’ll need the full set of architectural drawings in both PDF and editable formats (DWG or Revit preferred), along with any supporting schedules or notes required for permit submission. Looking forward to collaborating and creating a home that feels uniquely mine while staying practical for builders and inspectors alike.

opportunities.title: HighLevel Setup for Meredith Manor Venue
opportunities.description: I am moving Meredith Manor Venue onto its own, fully independent HighLevel account and I want every moving part of our current system replicated and improved. Your first task is to pull all existing contacts into the new workspace, then rebuild every automation we already rely on while mapping out the complete bride-and-groom journey from the first website visit through final follow-up. Each of those pieces—contact import, automation rebuild, and journey mapping—matters equally, so plan to work on them in parallel rather than sequentially. Once the core is live, I need you to comb through meredithmanorvenue.com and every social channel linked from it. I’m looking for practical suggestions that will tighten our lead flow, raise conversion rates, and keep the voice on-brand for an engaged-couple audience. If a tweak inside HighLevel (forms, funnels, SMS, email, calendars, triggers) can solve a problem, outline it; if something on the public site needs design, copy, or UX love, spell that out too. Because weddings are a niche of their own, strong HighLevel experience in three specific areas is critical: • sales and lead follow-up for wedding venues, • migrating contacts and automations between accounts, and • building forms, text messages, and email sequences that nurture couples seamlessly. Quick and accurate communication throughout the entire booking process is also essential. Additionally, this will be an ongoing project involving updates such as new open house dates and sales events. When you respond, focus on the relevant experience that proves you’ve done this before. Links or screenshots of similar HighLevel builds for venues or events work best. I will share current snapshots, access credentials, and priorities once we agree on the approach, and I expect clear communication while milestones move forward.

opportunities.title: LinkedIn & Facebook Outreach Setup
opportunities.description: I’m ready to launch a structured outreach campaign across LinkedIn and Facebook and need a specialist who can take the idea from concept to live execution. The end result I’m after is a steady flow of qualified conversations with the right prospects, so every step—from targeting to follow-up—has to be tight and trackable. Here’s what I have now: company profiles on both platforms, a clear value proposition, and a rough idea of my ideal buyer. What I need is the know-how and hands-on support to turn those pieces into a working outreach system. You’ll map out audiences, craft message sequences that feel personal, set up any automation or tracking tools we decide on (e.g., LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Meta Business Suite, HubSpot, or similar), and keep performance data organized so we can iterate quickly. Deliverables I’d like to see • Targeting brief that outlines personas, keywords, and platform filters • Connection / friend request copy, first touch, and follow-up messages ready to deploy • Outreach workflow implemented and tested on both platforms • Tracking sheet or CRM view showing sent messages, replies, and next actions • Short performance recap after two weeks with recommendations for tweaks Once everything is up and running smoothly and the first batch of metrics looks solid, we can discuss scaling or adding ad spend. If you’ve built similar social outreach funnels before and can show measurable results, I’d love to hear how you’d approach this.

opportunities.title: AutoCAD CCTV Cabling Layout Plans
opportunities.description: I have an office-style commercial space and I need a clean, professional AutoCAD drawing that focuses on the cabling and equipment layout for the CCTV system. The plan must clearly show every camera position, each power point that feeds the cameras, and the exact routing of cable trays from the devices back to the head-end. What I will hand over: the floor plan in DWG, a rough sketch indicating preferred camera spots, and basic device specs. What I expect back: • A layered DWG (and matching PDF) with cameras, power outlets, and tray routes clearly differentiated by line weight or colour • Simple legends and labels so an installer can follow the drawing without extra clarification • Neat scaling, tidy dimensions, and no unexplained blocks or proxy objects I am flexible on minor presentation conventions, but the core requirement is absolute clarity for the installation team. If you regularly prepare low-voltage or security layouts, this should be straightforward. Please include a quick note on similar work you’ve completed and your typical turnaround time.

opportunities.title: Client Acquisition Executive for Web Projects -- 2
opportunities.description: Details In Short: We need an experienced commission-based Business Development / Client Acquisition Executive who can get us new clients. Duration: 1 month to 1.5 month (15 nov - 31 dec) First client: 15 days Rest 3 client: 30 days (10 days each for one) Budget 10,000rs (In milestones, 2500rs per converted client, converted client project value should be above 5000rs, + Additonal delivery help) Pay: milestone based, we will create two milestones worth of 2500rs each for kickstart the project, rest two as project goes. Target: 4 paying clients. Prefered Freelancer: In Indian, who understand local language and demand, and how to talk to potential client, has done similar work before, deal with client in professional manner. Previous experience in sales, business development, lead generation or client acquisition is preferred. Languages: Hindi, english or both Target Locations: Mandsaur,MP Nimach, Manasa, Jaora, Ratlam, Targeted Clients: people who need portfolio websites, small business like beauty parlors, gyms, etc looking for their online presence, people who need website or an app. We are interested in businesses and individuals who need an online presence or digital solutions. Examples include: ⦁ Beauty parlours and salons. ⦁ Gyms and fitness centres. ⦁ Restaurants and cafes. ⦁ Local shops and small businesses. ⦁ Professionals who need portfolio/personal websites. ⦁ Businesses looking for website development. ⦁ Individuals or businesses requiring custom applications. Responsibilities ⦁ Research and identify potential clients. ⦁ Find businesses through Google Maps, social media and other platforms. ⦁ Contact potential clients through calls, WhatsApp, social media or cold emails. ⦁ Understand their business requirements and identify opportunities. ⦁ Present our website and application development services. ⦁ Explain the proposed solution and communicate with potential customers. ⦁ Follow up with interested prospects and handle initial negotiations. ⦁ Convert interested prospects into confirmed paying clients. We will provide the necessary service details, pricing information and proposals to help you pitch our services. What you will do: 1. find potential clients. 2. reach them. 3. understand their business and give details to me. 4. I'll make demo screens and details and send to you. 4. pitch them offer and shows demo 5. your milestone payment is done after they give full project with us. the you can work on next client. 6. Keep track in shared spreedsheet of Businesses contacted, Interested prospects, Meetings, discussions arranged, Proposals sent, Paying clients acquired. Definition of a Successful Conversion A client will be considered successfully converted when ⦁ The client agrees to proceed with a development project. ⦁ The project requirements and pricing are confirmed. If unsuccessfull: If you fail to get first client within 21 days, we will terminate the contract and will look for someone else repeat the process for 4 clients. About Us: we are locally(Mp) based 4-5 developers want to startup agency. We do not estalished portfolio or website to show client. We will create after we have done some work to show, also we dont have linkedin

opportunities.title: Excel Task Deadlines Automation
opportunities.description: I have an existing Excel project-tracker and I need it to tell me, at a glance, exactly which tasks are due, which are overdue, and how many days remain before each deadline. Right now the data is all there—task names, owners, start-finish dates—but the sheet is static. I want to transform it with modern, spill-enabled array formulas so the information updates itself the moment I change a date or add a new row. What I expect • Dynamic formulas (e.g. FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE, LET, IF, SEQUENCE or similar) that pull from my current tables and return: – today’s due tasks – overdue tasks, clearly flagged – rolling countdown of days remaining for every open task • No macros or external add-ins; formulas only so the file stays lightweight and shareable. • Integration into my present worksheet layout—no need to rebuild the entire file, just insert the logic and any helper columns you find necessary. • Clear, inline comments or a short write-up so I can tweak date fields or ranges later without breaking the solution. Acceptance I’ll consider the job complete when I can open the tracker, change a task date, and instantly see the updated due/overdue status and day count with zero manual refresh.

opportunities.title: Automated Account Provisioning / Workflow using Axiom.AI and Cursor (READY TO HIRE!)
opportunities.description: (follow response instructions please!) Project Description: We are looking for a skilled developer to build an automated account provisioning system. The project combines a centralised admin dashboard (built and maintained using Cursor) that triggers Axiom.ai browser bots via webhooks to handle automated sign-ups across multiple websites that do not offer public APIs. Project Architecture & Goals: 1. Centralised Admin Dashboard: A lightweight web interface/database where our team can input user details, select target platforms, trigger sign-up workflows, and monitor success/failure statuses in real time. 2. opportunities.title: Modern Restaurant Renovation Design -- 2
opportunities.description: I’m ready to give my restaurant a fresh, modern-elegant identity while making room for more guests. The goal is to update the overall look and atmosphere, focusing specifically on the dining area and entrance. I want patrons to walk in and immediately feel contemporary sophistication—think clean lines, refined finishes, and smart lighting that highlights our existing character rather than erasing it. Here’s what I need from you: a complete interior concept that increases seating capacity without overcrowding, provides a smooth visual flow from the doorway to every table, and showcases a cohesive palette of materials, colors, and fixtures. Detailed floor plans, mood boards, and 3D renderings should clearly illustrate traffic circulation, table spacing, and any feature walls or statement pieces you recommend. Please include furniture specifications and lighting suggestions that fit both ambiance and practical service needs. Your design must comply with local codes for egress and accessibility; if you foresee challenges, flag them early with solutions. I’ll handle the build-out, so the final package should be ready for contractors—dimensioned drawings (CAD or Revit), annotated elevations, and a concise materials list with alternatives in case of supply issues. If this aligns with your expertise, share relevant restaurant or hospitality projects you’ve completed and outline your proposed timeline from concept to final documentation.

opportunities.title: Driver Recruitment Campaign for Delhi NCR
opportunities.description: ### Driver Recruitment Campaign – Commercial Electric 3-Wheeler & 4-Wheeler Vehicles **Objective:** To launch a comprehensive driver recruitment and digital marketing campaign across India to hire drivers for commercial electric 3-wheeler (3W) and 4-wheeler (4W) vehicles operated by RR Mobility. **1. Digital Advertising and Recruitment Channels** Promote driver hiring advertisements across all major digital and social media platforms, including: - Facebook and Instagram advertising. - Google Ads and Google Display Network. - WhatsApp groups and community networks. - WhatsApp message circulation and referral networks. - Other relevant online job portals and digital recruitment platforms. **2. Target Recruitment Locations** Focus on high-population states and regions with a strong potential workforce, particularly: - Uttar Pradesh - Bihar - Madhya Pradesh - Jharkhand - Delhi NCR The campaign should specifically target candidates from semi-urban and rural areas who are willing to relocate to Delhi NCR for employment opportunities. **3. Job Locations – Delhi NCR** The available job opportunities are primarily concentrated in: - West Delhi - Gurugram - Noida - Faridabad Selected candidates will be deployed across these locations based on operational requirements. **4. Accommodation and Food Facilities** To encourage candidates from outside Delhi NCR to relocate for employment, RR Mobility will provide: - Accommodation facilities. - Food facilities. These benefits will be extended to eligible drivers migrating from other states to work in Delhi NCR. **5. Key Campaign Focus** The primary objective is to generate a consistent pipeline of qualified commercial vehicle drivers for both electric 3-wheelers and 4-wheelers. The advertising strategy should focus on: - Maximum candidate reach across targeted states. - High-volume driver registrations and enquiries. - Targeted advertising to individuals actively seeking driving jobs. - Recruitment of candidates willing to relocate to Delhi NCR. - Consistent follow-up and conversion of enquiries into actual driver onboarding. **Expected Outcome:** Establish a scalable driver recruitment network to fulfil RR Mobility's ongoing and future manpower requirements across Delhi NCR.

opportunities.title: Funny Rap Diss Animation
opportunities.description: I’m putting together a light-hearted, 40-second (or longer) 2D diss-track video. Picture one cartoon character centre-stage, spitting playful bars at a rival who never actually appears, while on-screen gags and sight jokes land in sync with the beat. The tone has to stay funny and cheeky rather than aggressive, so think bright colours, snappy timing, and plenty of visual punch lines. What I already have: • Concept and overall structure: one rapper character clowning the off-screen opponent. • A rough draft of the lyrics. What I need from you: • Original 2D animation (frame-by-frame or rigged) that runs at least 40 seconds. • A catchy backing track that fits hip-hop/rap pacing; feel free to build loops or compose fresh. • Full audio mix: vocal, beat, sound effects, mastered and synced to the animation. • Delivery in HD (1920×1080) MP4, plus separate WAV of the final mix so I can drop it on other platforms. Acceptance criteria: — Visual humour clearly supports the lyrics (think exaggerated reactions, props, meme-style cutaways). — Lip-sync is tight; words match mouth shapes throughout. — Final render plays smoothly, no dropped frames, audio stays in sync from start to finish. Software is up to you—Adobe Animate, Toon Boom, After Effects, Blender Grease Pencil—so long as the result looks clean and professional. If you’re comfortable handling both animation and music production, great; otherwise let me know how you’d source or create the beat. Send over a short reel or link to past fun, music-driven 2D work in your first message so I can get a feel for your style. Looking forward to roasting this rival in the most entertaining way possible!

opportunities.title: Realistic 3D Snacks Ad Video
opportunities.description: I need a short, punchy 3D advertisement that shows my product in a hyper-realistic way and instantly grabs attention on social media feeds. The spot should highlight the item’s form, finish, and any standout details without heavy text overlays—think cinematic lighting, smooth camera moves, and subtle motion graphics that keep the focus on the product itself. Scope • Model refinement or full model build if required, matched exactly to my reference photos or CAD. • Photo-real texturing, lighting, and rendering that will hold up on high-resolution mobile screens. • A 15–30 second final edit optimized for Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok (vertical and square crops). • Background music or sound design that fits the visual mood (royalty-free only). • One round of revisions for timing, camera angles, and color tweaks. Source project files (Blender, Cinema 4D, or 3ds Max—use the package you’re fastest in). I’ll supply product imagery, logo, and any brand guidelines right after kickoff. Please share a few links to realistic 3D ads you’ve produced so I can gauge style fit, and let me know your estimated turnaround time.

opportunities.title: WordPress FAQ Chatbot Setup
opportunities.description: I need a chat bot added to my WordPress site that can instantly answer the most common customer questions. I will supply a clear, well-structured list of questions and answers; the bot should draw exclusively from that list when it responds. Scope of work • Select or recommend a reliable WordPress-compatible chat bot solution (native plugin or API-based is fine). • Configure the bot, import my Q&A list, and train it so replies stay on-topic and accurate. • Style the chat widget so it matches my site’s branding and works smoothly on desktop and mobile. • Test across modern browsers to confirm the bot loads quickly, responds correctly, and logs basic chat history for review. Key expectations • No scraping—the bot must reference only the provided Q&A. • Replies should appear instantly and handle simple variations of each question. • Final delivery includes the configured plugin, any custom code snippets, and a short hand-over guide so I can update the Q&A list myself. If you have previous WordPress chatbot projects, links or screenshots would help me decide quickly.

opportunities.title: Comercial Software Contable
opportunities.description: Busco a una persona con perfil claramente comercial que me ayude a introducir mi software contable en el mercado colombiano, enfocándose de forma prioritaria en firmas contables, contadores y empresas. Lo que necesito de ti • Localizar firmas, contadores y empresas en Colombia que encajen con nuestra propuesta. • Contactar a los decisores, presentarles brevemente la solución y, sobre todo, concertar una reunión (online o presencial) para que yo pueda realizar la demo y la negociación final. • Entregarme un reporte semanal con el número de contactos realizados, reuniones agendadas y comentarios relevantes de cada prospecto. Qué valoraré • Experiencia previa captando clientes B2B, idealmente dentro del sector software o servicios para contabilidad. • Conocimiento del tejido empresarial contable colombiano y habilidad para llegar a socios o gerentes. • Habilidades sólidas de comunicación y uso eficiente de canales como LinkedIn, correo electrónico o llamadas en frío. Entregables esperados 1. Base de datos propia con los leads generados (nombre de la firma, contacto principal, cargo, correo/teléfono). 2. Agenda compartida con las reuniones confirmadas. 3. Informe semanal con métricas y observaciones. Si ya cuentas con una red de contactos en este nicho, coméntamelo; será un punto a favor. Espero tu propuesta y cuántas reuniones estimas poder cerrar en el primer mes.

opportunities.title: Canal de Youtube: Diseño de Minautura , Edición e Video, Copywriter...
opportunities.description: Estamos buscando un equipo de profesionales freelance altamente talentosos para el lanzamiento y la gestión continua de nuestro primer canal de YouTube. Nuestro objetivo es establecer una presencia sólida y distintiva desde el inicio, con un enfoque en la identidad visual, la producción de contenido de alta calidad y una estrategia de comunicación efectiva. Los roles clave que buscamos cubrir son: 1. Diseñador de Miniaturas para YouTube: Necesitamos un experto en diseño de miniaturas que comprenda la psicología del clic y la importancia de la atracción visual en YouTube. Buscamos a alguien con experiencia demostrable en la creación de miniaturas que generen engagement, o un talento con gran potencial y un ojo excepcional para el diseño, dispuesto a aprender y crecer con nuestro equipo para alcanzar resultados de alto nivel. 2. Editor de Video Creativo: Requerimos un editor de video con amplia experiencia y una gran capacidad creativa. El dominio de Adobe After Effects y otras herramientas de edición es esencial. El contenido principal será en formato podcast sin mostrar el rostro, lo que exige la incorporación de elementos visuales dinámicos. Las responsabilidades incluirán la creación de una apertura inicial impactante para el canal, la integración de gráficos y animaciones durante las conversaciones, la gestión de cambios de slides en momentos estratégicos y el diseño de un cierre efectivo que impulse la interacción, la retención y la participación de la audiencia. 3. Especialista en Contenido y Estrategia: Buscamos un profesional con habilidades destacadas en copywriting y desarrollo de contenido. Esta persona será fundamental para generar textos atractivos, proponer ideas de contenido innovadoras y definir estrategias de comunicación que resuenen con nuestra audiencia. Aunque es nuestro primer canal de YouTube, nuestra marca posee una vasta experiencia en branding, marketing y comunicación visual, por lo que esperamos un enfoque estratégico y de alta calidad. Valoramos el compromiso, la creatividad y la seriedad profesional. Queremos construir un equipo de alto rendimiento que comparta nuestra visión de excelencia y nos ayude a asegurar un lanzamiento exitoso y un crecimiento sostenido del canal. Categoría: Diseño y Multimedia Subcategoría: Imagen Corporativa ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Definir desde cero

opportunities.title: Rustic-Modern Gathering Space and office Design
opportunities.description: figured mostly interior design you dont have to have all the bells and whistles when it comes to computer work, but I want to be able to fully visually see it. I’m re-imagining an open gathering room that holds a kitchen, bar, and ventless rock fireplace, plus a compact adjoining office. what I need now is a fresh design eye that ties everything together. Needing an interior designer i believe. I have somewhat one design but want another perspective view. for the outside of the building i need stain or paint color, any window decor and lighting ideas and if awning is necessary. For the bar and kitchen zone I picture a western lodge mood—natural wood, stone, and a cozy glow—but I’m equally curious to see how a cleaner, modern twist could look in the office and parts of the main space. Floor stain or paint color, cabinet profiles, shelving layouts, ceiling treatment (spray-in insulation left exposed and painted, or a full rafter cover), lighting layers, and wall colors are all still undecided.- not afraid to repurpose items for the look, Here’s what I’d like from you: • Two fully developed concept directions (one heavier on rural rustic, one that blends in modern touches). • Scaled cabinet, shelf, and bar elevations with material specs. • Palette boards for floor, wall, and ceiling finishes—including stain/paint names or codes. • Lighting plan with fixture suggestions and photometric notes. • Ceiling solution sketches comparing the painted-rafter route to a clad alternative.- leaning hard on spray on insulation on the ceiling as for insulation, can leave it exposed or if you have a better idea. • A concise office layout showing storage cabinetry that compliments whichever concept wins. • 3D views or SketchUp/AutoCAD renderings so I can feel the spaces before committing. I will choose the final direction based on how well it harmonises the fireplace corner, keeps the room feeling spacious, and fits everyday use as a family gathering hub. If you work in SketchUp, Revit, or a similar platform, all the better—I’ll need the source file alongside high-resolution images. Send over a quick outline of how you’d tackle the brief and samples of similar rustic-modern work you’ve done. I’m ready to move quickly once I see a vision that clicks.

opportunities.title: Native Android Rebuild for NUNU
opportunities.description: I need the current NUNU web application (https://nunutech.ai.studio), which was prototyped in Google AI Studio, rebuilt as a fully native Android app. Every feature that exists online today—user roles, dashboards, login and signup flows, data visualisations—must work exactly the same way on the phone while continuing to talk to the very same backend and database that power the site. You will receive the full source code on GitHub and in a ZIP archive. Use that as a reference for APIs, UI, and logic, but translate the experience into Kotlin/Java inside Android Studio so it feels like a real mobile product rather than a wrapped website. Key expectations • Match the current design closely, adding a launch splash screen and proper app icon. • Keep all authentication and authorisation behaviour intact. • Ensure dashboards render smoothly on common screen sizes and remain responsive in portrait and landscape. • Handle network states gracefully—if the device is offline, show a friendly message and retry automatically when the connection returns. • Thoroughly test every screen and interactive element before hand-over; I will run a final acceptance test on a physical device. Deliverables 1. Release-ready, signed APK. 2. Complete Android Studio project with clear build instructions. When you reply, please share similar native Android builds you have completed, a rough delivery timeline, and any questions you need answered before you start.

opportunities.title: Houdini FX for Film CGI
opportunities.description: I have a fully computer-generated shot for a film sequence that needs a high-calibre Houdini effect. Because everything in the scene is synthetic, you will have complete control over lighting, scale, and timing without the complications of live-action plates. I’ll supply the base 3D assets, camera layout, and the look-dev references; you handle the simulation, shot integration, and delivery of clean caches plus a preview render. The exact phenomenon—fire, water, destruction, or something more abstract—will be finalised with you once I’ve seen your reel, so bring your creative ideas. What matters is a photoreal finish that cuts seamlessly into a cinematic edit. Houdini (19.5 or newer) is mandatory; Karma, Mantra, Redshift, or Arnold are all viable for look-dev, as long as the final VDB/ABC caches and an EXR turn-over are included. Deliverables need to hit these marks: • Houdini project file with clearly named nodes and no missing dependencies • Simulation caches ready for farm rendering • A beauty pass play-blast plus a final EXR sequence for approval Once the effect matches the reference and passes a round of notes, I’ll sign off. Let’s create a standout visual moment.

opportunities.title: Reemplazo realista de integrante en fotos
opportunities.description: Necesito editar 50 fotos de grupo para sustituir siempre a la misma persona por un nuevo integrante. Entrego imágenes del nuevo miembro tanto en solitario como con el mismo grupo, tomadas en la misma sesión, así que el ángulo, la iluminación y el vestuario ya coinciden en la mayoría de los casos. Objetivo • El montaje debe ser invisible: mismos tonos, contraste, texturas y resolución que la foto original. • Rostros y proporciones impecables, sin deformaciones ni rastros de recorte. • Coherencia de color y luz en cada imagen para que nadie note la intervención. Flujo de trabajo sugerido 1. Seleccionar la referencia adecuada del nuevo integrante para cada toma. 2. Integrar con precisión (máscara, ajuste de color, dodge & burn, corrección selectiva). 3. Revisar piel, sombras y reflejos para mantener la naturalidad. 4. Entregar los 50 archivos finales en la resolución original, mismos formatos y nombres de archivo si es posible, listos para impresión y uso digital. Valoro dominio de Photoshop y técnicas de composición avanzada; se aprecian ejemplos previos de retoque de retrato o fotomontaje. Confermo los reemplazos uno a uno para asegurar consistencia antes de cerrar el proyecto. Se paga por la edicion de una foto, si el trabajo esta OK se paga completo por las otras 49

opportunities.title: 3D Printing Expert Needed to Optimize a Clear PETG Filament Printed Model for Glass-Like Clarity With PETG Filament
opportunities.description: You must be a 3D printing expert. I will reject all other bids. DO NOT BID: if you don't have 3 years of 3D filament printing design experience and can make 3D filament prints Glass Clear. I’m looking for someone experienced in 3D printing clear and translucent PETG to clean up my existing 3D print file and optimize it for my Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2 with a 0.8 mm nozzle. I would like my project completed in 5 days. You will adjust the work until it is what I need. My project includes the 3MF file. I need daily updates and screen shots and or screen capture videos so I can add my input if needed. I will require you to sign my work made for hire agreement, and my non reverse engineer agreement. The goal is to make the clear and translucent areas as close to glass-clear as practical and keep the translucent colored areas distinct and light-transmitting. Adjust the height and width size and preserve the existing shape, thickness, and color pattern. I will provide the dimensions. Deliverables - A corrected, print-ready 3MF project with the filament assignments and slicer settings saved. - Short instructions for printing it, including any steps needed to achieve the best clarity. - Photos of previous clear PETG prints you’ve made. Please say whether you can test-print a sample using a 0.8 mm nozzle and show the result in normal light and with backlighting to show how clear it is. In your proposal, briefly describe your experience with clear PETG and what level of clarity you expect to achieve. I will own the full and exclusive copyrights to all 3MF files, G files, text, images, raw files, source files, project files, and all work created for me. opportunities.title: Pulso Digital | Noticias de Negocios Online
opportunities.description: Crear un portal de noticias en español sobre negocios online, emprendimiento, comercio electrónico, marketing digital, inteligencia artificial y tecnología aplicada a las empresas. Estará dirigido a emprendedores, profesionales y lectores de Argentina y Latinoamérica. El sitio tendrá un diseño profesional, rápido y adaptable a celulares, con navegación sencilla y las siguientes secciones: - Actualidad de negocios digitales. - Comercio electrónico y tiendas online. - Marketing y redes sociales. - Inteligencia artificial y tecnología. - Emprendimiento y casos de negocios. - Guías prácticas y análisis. Cada publicación deberá ofrecer contenido original, útil y verificado, con título claro, autor, fecha y fuentes cuando corresponda. Se evitarán noticias inventadas, artículos copiados y promesas de ganancias garantizadas. Las imágenes deberán ser propias o contar con permiso de uso. Incluirá páginas de Quiénes somos, Contacto, Política de privacidad, Política de cookies, Términos de uso y Política editorial. La portada destacará las últimas noticias y permitirá explorar los artículos por categoría. El objetivo es desarrollar un medio informativo confiable, atraer lectores mediante contenido de calidad y preparar el sitio para solicitar monetización con Google AdSense, con espacios publicitarios que respeten la experiencia de lectura.

opportunities.title: Trafficker Digital Multimarca Senior
opportunities.description: Trafficker Digital Senior Modalidad: Freelance / Remoto Presupuesto mensual: USD $250 total al mes Gestión: Publicidad digital de 10 marcas Horario de disponibilidad: Lunes a viernes, preferiblemente de 8:00 a.m. a 5:00 p.m. (hora Panamá). Perfil requerido Buscamos un Trafficker Digital Freelancer que hable y escriba español nativo, con mínimo 3 años de experiencia comprobable gestionando campañas publicitarias y optimizando resultados en diferentes plataformas. Debe contar con portafolio de trabajos, casos de éxito y referencias verificables. Experiencia y conocimientos Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram): campañas de mensajes, leads, agendamiento de citas y conversiones. Google Ads: campañas SEM, búsqueda y Performance Max. LinkedIn Ads y TikTok Ads. Looker Studio: reportes y dashboards de resultados. Experiencia promocionando negocios de salud, belleza, restaurantes, SaaS, aplicaciones web, cursos y eventos. Conocimiento de píxeles, eventos, seguimiento y medición de conversiones. Creatividad y diseño Debe saber desarrollar diferentes ángulos publicitarios, conceptos de anuncios y propuestas creativas según cada público y negocio. Se valorará que tenga conocimientos de diseño y pueda crear o adaptar piezas gráficas cuando sea necesario, utilizando Canva, Photoshop u otras herramientas. Responsabilidades Desarrollar la estrategia publicitaria de cada marca. Coordinar las necesidades de diseño y creatividad. Configurar, ejecutar y administrar campañas. Realizar seguimiento y optimización diaria de conversiones y resultados. Administrar presupuestos y proponer mejoras. Crear y presentar reportes de resultados en Looker Studio. Trabajar alineado con los equipos comerciales y de ventas para medir la calidad de los prospectos, citas agendadas y ventas generadas. Participar en reuniones con clientes para presentar estrategias, resultados y propuestas de mejora. Disponibilidad Se requiere disponibilidad de lunes a viernes, preferiblemente de 8:00 a.m. a 5:00 p.m. (Panamá), para seguimiento, coordinación y reuniones con clientes y equipo interno. Para aplicar Enviar: Portafolio de campañas gestionadas. Casos de éxito con resultados comprobables. Referencias de clientes o empresas anteriores. Breve descripción de su experiencia y plataformas que domina. Buscamos una persona estratégica, creativa, organizada y orientada a resultados, capaz de gestionar la publicidad de 10 marcas de diferentes industrias con autonomía y criterio comercial. Honorarios mensuales: USD $250 total al mes por la gestión de todas las marcas.
